add.name: Starry Sea Busan Night Market, Hwamyeong Eco Park
add.desc: A seasonal night market in the lotus complex of Hwamyeong Eco Park, next to the Hwamyeong auto-camping site (Nakdong River Bike Path 1425, Buk-gu), with the Nakdong River beside it. In 2026 it ran twice: 10–14 June, and 26 September to 18 October on Thursday, Friday and Saturday 17:00–22:00 and Sunday 16:00–21:00. Programmes: traditional liquor and makgeolli pop-ups, food trucks, picnic platforms under the sunset, brew-your-own-liquor and cooking classes, and a local flea market. Both 2026 seasons have ended and the next dates are not announced, so check before you go. Schedule: Visit Busan · booking page: event-us.kr · Instagram @starrynightbusan.

add.name: Anmok Busan Station – pork gukbap
add.desc: Jungang-daero 214beon-gil 3-10, Dong-gu, near Busan Station. A pork gukbap (rice soup) house; reviews also mention suyuk (boiled pork slices), sundae (blood sausage) and a self-service side-dish bar, and its description of a cold suyuk plate lists shank, head meat and Duroc pork belly. Hours on Naver (2026-10-25): Mon–Thu 11:00–21:00, Fri–Sun 10:00–21:00. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-25.

add.name: Anmok Seomyeon – pork gukbap
add.desc: Seomyeon-ro 10, ground floor, units 121 and 122, Busanjin-gu, in Seomyeon. The Seomyeon branch of the same pork gukbap house; the restaurant says its broth is simmered long and finished with its own sauce. Hours on Naver (2026-10-25): Mon–Fri 10:00–22:00, Sat–Sun 09:00–21:00. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-25.

add.name: Ochoryang – tea house and gallery
add.desc: Gogwan-ro 13beon-na-gil 22, ground floor, Choryang, Dong-gu. A tea house and small gallery in a wooden Japanese-style house built in 1925, with a garden. A visit is about 1 hour 30 minutes of exhibition and tea, booked on Naver; one visitor's post lists ₩28,000. Hours on Naver (2026-10-25): Wed–Sun 10:30–15:30, closed Mondays and Tuesdays. Naver gives the way: 5 minutes on foot from Choryang Station exits 7 and 9, about 15 minutes from Busan Station.
